asked: Do the units of the range formula actually work out?
answer: notes up. Right now, we’re on the middle section, which includes y of x as a parabola, plus the time of flight, maximum height, and range results. Yes. Range R is v0 squared over g times sin 2 theta. v0 squared has units of length squared over time squared. g is length over time squared. Divide them, you get length, and the sine is just a pure number.
